tasks_output.description:
You have access to MedGemma clinical AI via the medgemma_recommender tool.
CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: You MUST call the medgemma_recommender tool. Do NOT generate clinical recommendations from your own knowledge. The clinical reasoning MUST come from an actual medgemma_recommender tool call. If you skip the tool call, the output will be invalid.
PATIENT DATA AVAILABLE: - Patient Summary: Output from summarize_patient_profile task (concise natural language summary) - MedGemma ingredients: Output from discover_ingredients_medgemma task (evidence-based candidate ingredients)
MANDATORY TASK - EXECUTE TOOL CALL: 1. Call the medgemma_recommender tool with:
   - patient_summary: The full patient summary from summarize_patient_profile task
   - candidate_ingredients: The discovered ingredients JSON from discover_ingredients_medgemma task

2. Wait for MedGemma's response with clinical analysis and prioritized recommendations
3. Structure MedGemma's recommendations into the required JSON format
IMPORTANT: - MedGemma handles all clinical reasoning and prioritization - Your role is to call the tool and structure the output into valid JSON - Preserve MedGemma's clinical reasoning in the "why" field - Ensure 8-12 recommendations are included - Maintain the clinical priority ranking from MedGemma
CRITICAL: Output ONLY the JSON structure. No explanatory text or reasoning outside the JSON.

- **Mitochondrial & Energy Metabolism (MITO)**: 1.69
- **Detoxification & Biotransformation (DTX)**: 1.59
- **Skin & Barrier Function (SKN)**: 1.58
- **Cognitive & Mental Health (COG)**: 1.35
- **Hormonal Health (Transport) (HRM)**: 1.10 (patient's health priorities with scores)
FOCUS AREA CODES (assign 1-2 per supplement): - CM: Cardiometabolic & Metabolic Health (cholesterol, blood sugar, heart health) - COG: Cognitive & Mental Health (brain function, mood, memory) - DTX: Detoxification & Biotransformation (liver function, toxin clearance) - IMM: Immune Function & Inflammation (immune support, reducing inflammation) - MITO: Mitochondrial & Energy Metabolism (cellular energy, fatigue) - SKN: Skin & Barrier Function (skin health, wound healing) - STR: Stress-Axis & Nervous System Resilience (stress response, adrenals) - HRM: Hormonal Health (thyroid, sex hormones, hormone transport) - GA: Gut Health and Assimilation (digestion, nutrient absorption)
FOR EACH SUPPLEMENT: 1. Look at the "why" field to understand what health issue it addresses 2. Match to 1-2 focus areas based on supplement's mechanism of action 3. Prioritize focus areas that are highest scored for this patient
CRITICAL: Output ONLY the JSON structure with focus areas added.
